name: wrapping
note: Inline-blocks wrap across lines with the surrounding text: a text badge and a sized badge sit inline with a narrow paragraph, and the text re-flows around them with the inline whitespace between elements respected (the badges break to later lines when they no longer fit). Layer-3 checks each badge and the multi-line text spans (union rects) against Chrome; layer-4 compares the badge backgrounds strictly.
